title: Property Management Admin
description: Admin dashboard untuk managing property inventory catalog dengan CRUD operations. Image upload to Vercel Blob, property status tracking, photo section assignment. Static auth via env variables.

inScope: CRUD operations untuk property inventory catalog
Image upload to Vercel Blob untuk property photos
Admin selects which photos appear in each section (Hero, Showcase)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Admin can create new property listing dengan semua required fields
Admin can upload property photos ke Vercel Blob via dashboard
Admin can set property status: available, sold, atau rented
Admin can designate which photo appears in Hero section
Admin can designate which properties appear in Showcase section
Login with static credentials from env vars, session via signed cookie
